input.steer: target heading error / 0.35 - 0.25 * actual heading yaw rate; cap 0.2 and slew 0.4/s from first target, including prone
input.popup: one pulse while prone in first ordinary go, independently of qualified target: cue OR valid ahead[0,8]m, faceFraction>=0.35 and shorewardSpeed>=2m/s
input.crouch: 1 on earliest input whose published phase is standing

selector.candidates: joined same-front row pairs, formed>0, weight>=0.5, phase1, finite life[0,1), fade1; midpoint contour intervals with 3 strict crossings then exact indexed shortlist
selector.demand: Geometric target: nominal crouched head TOP1.13m already includes reference radius, plus0.1m explicit deck allowance, retained while ordinary crouch settles. Standing: separately record actual published head centre+radius-boardY plus deck allowance and height deficit. Actual witness/clearance judgement uses actual body only.
selector.lock: first qualified front ID, choose nearest qualified candidate air column on that front thereafter; no cross-front retarget; terminate when locked target is lost
selector.scope: Candidate air column on one connected mesh component with nominal vertical head height; no validated mouth/corridor, reachable passage, air-volume connectivity, prepared posture or full body fit. Record interval world width/head diameter and sliceMouth formed-boundary sigma distance; actual published-body witness remains entry gate.

movie.trigger: standing and drawn loft indices>0 and (qualified actual candidate air column within15m OR partial/contained witness)

beforeFreezeCorrections: Nominal1.13m is a head TOP including reference radius, not a centre; no doubled radius
Keep actual phase1 closing-life[0.8,1) openings eligible while exact geometry has clearance
Lock and retain nominally usable geometric target while actual head settles; record actual standing demand/deficit without claiming prepared pose or entry.

Candidate is an exact indexed air column; no validated mouth or corridor. Width vs head diameter and formed-run boundary sigma distance are logged. Selector per-call1s or remaining total20s budget, whichever smaller.
Independent once-only normal valid manual pop-up prepares ordinary stance even before a qualified local air-column target exists; this does not assert a future opening.

rawFrontEvidence.scope: Existing published joined raw front records only; private unjoined CrestTracks are unavailable. Exact phase from accepted Padang library headers and current raw height/depth/tau; nearest drawn row metadata is separate actual-geometry evidence. Published-board gauge crest approximation is explicitly approximate.
